title: Christin Stewart drew a four-pitch walk to lead off the ninth and Josh Harrison
snippet: Christin Stewart drew a four-pitch walk to lead off the ninth and Josh Harrison pinch-ran for him and stole second base. The Tigers are a single away from tying the game again.
